data.label:
Asset
entity · active
data.name: Asset
data.sub:
A physical production asset with a health state. Abstract class covering Equipment. Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
0 representation(s)

data.label:
Business Process
entity · active
data.name: BusinessProcess
data.sub:
An SAP end-to-end process, e.g. Design to Operate. A kind of Catalog Object. In the supply chain model: A Business Process contains a Data Product (1:N). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
CDS Entity
entity · active
data.name: CDSEntity
data.sub:
A CDS view exposed by a data product. A kind of Catalog Object. In the supply chain model: A CDS Entity is associated with another CDS Entity (N:N). A Data Product exposes a CDS Entity (1:N). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Catalog Object
entity · active
data.name: CatalogObject
data.sub:
An SAP Business Data Cloud catalog artefact. Kept as a separate branch: it describes what data exists, not what the supply chain is. Abstract class covering Business Process, Data Product, CDS Entity. Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Component Lot
entity · active
data.name: ComponentLot
data.sub:
A received supplier lot of a BOM component, with inspection result. A kind of Item. In the supply chain model: A Component Lot is supplied by a Supplier (N:1). A System Serial contains a Component Lot (N:N). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
2 representation(s)

data.label:
Customer
entity · active
data.name: Customer
data.sub:
An organisation that receives finished output. A kind of Party. In the supply chain model: A Plant ships to a Customer (N:N). A Sales Order is placed by a Customer (N:1). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Data Product
entity · active
data.name: DataProduct
data.sub:
A BDC data product exposing CDS entities. A kind of Catalog Object. In the supply chain model: A Business Process contains a Data Product (1:N). A Data Product exposes a CDS Entity (1:N). A Data Product shares a canonical object with another Data Product (N:N). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Equipment
entity · active
data.name: Equipment
data.sub:
A production tool (stepper, etcher, CVD chamber, assembly cell) at a work center. A kind of Asset. In the supply chain model: An Equipment is installed at a Plant (N:1). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
3 representation(s)

data.label:
Facility
entity · active
data.name: Facility
data.sub:
A physical site with capacity. Abstract: the network has only plants today, but distribution centres and contract manufacturers are the same kind of thing. Abstract class covering Plant. Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Inbound Flow
entity · active
data.name: InboundFlow
data.sub:
Supplier to plant. A kind of Material Flow. Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Inter Plant Flow
entity · active
data.name: InterPlantFlow
data.sub:
Plant to plant. The mechanism by which a disruption travels. A kind of Material Flow. Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Item
entity · active
data.name: Item
data.sub:
A traceable physical unit. Abstract class covering System Serial, Component Lot. Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
0 representation(s)

data.label:
Material Category
term · active
data.name: MaterialCategory
data.sub:
A class of material the network moves. Sole-source risk is a property of a category, not of a plant, which is why it needs to be its own class. In the supply chain model: A Material Flow carries a Material Category (N:1). A Plant produces a Material Category (N:N). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
2 representation(s)

data.label:
Material Flow
entity · active
data.name: MaterialFlow
data.sub:
A recurring movement of one material category between two entities, carrying monthly volume and value. Reified as a class because the flow itself has attributes the endpoints do not. Abstract class covering Inbound Flow, Outbound Flow, Inter Plant Flow. In the supply chain model: A Material Flow carries a Material Category (N:1). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Outbound Flow
entity · active
data.name: OutboundFlow
data.sub:
Plant to customer. Where revenue is at risk. A kind of Material Flow. Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Party
entity · active
data.name: Party
data.sub:
An external organisation the network trades with. Abstract, so a question about 'who is affected' can span suppliers and customers in one answer. Abstract class covering Supplier, Customer. Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Plant
entity · active
data.name: Plant
data.sub:
A manufacturing site. Carries capacity (work centres, hours, spare units) and inventory (days of cover, stock value) as properties, because both are 1:1 with the plant rather than entities in their own right. A kind of Facility. In the supply chain model: A Plant can substitute for another Plant (N:N). A Plant produces a Material Category (N:N). A Plant ships to a Customer (N:N). A Plant transfers material to another Plant (N:N). A Sales Order is fulfilled by a Plant (N:1). A Supplier supplies a Plant (N:N). A System Serial is built at a Plant (N:1). An Equipment is installed at a Plant (N:1). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
3 representation(s)

data.label:
Sales Order
entity · active
data.name: SalesOrder
data.sub:
A customer order line for an inspection system, with OTIF outcome and late cost. A kind of Transaction. In the supply chain model: A Sales Order is fulfilled by a Plant (N:1). A Sales Order is placed by a Customer (N:1). A System Serial is shipped on a Sales Order (N:1). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
2 representation(s)

data.label:
Supplier
entity · active
data.name: Supplier
data.sub:
An organisation that ships material into a plant. A kind of Party. In the supply chain model: A Component Lot is supplied by a Supplier (N:1). A Supplier supplies a Plant (N:N). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
System Serial
entity · active
data.name: SystemSerial
data.sub:
One built inspection system, identified by serial number. A kind of Item. In the supply chain model: A System Serial contains a Component Lot (N:N). A System Serial is built at a Plant (N:1). A System Serial is shipped on a Sales Order (N:1). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
1 representation(s)

data.label:
Transaction
entity · active
data.name: Transaction
data.sub:
A business document that commits the supply chain to deliver. Abstract class covering Sales Order. Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
0 representation(s)
